{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:\n', df.head())

# Check for missing values in the two columns of interest
print('\nMissing values in flipper_length_mm:', df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())
print('Missing values in body_mass_g:', df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', df.duplicated().sum())"}
